final_resume.summary: Software Engineer II candidate with a B.Tech in Information Technology and 6 months of backend development experience building Java and Spring Boot REST services. Demonstrated strong problem-solving and code quality focus through test-driven development and production bug resolution. Seeking to contribute to distributed systems and large-scale product development at Google Cloud.

projects.name: ShopEase - E-commerce Store
projects.description: Architected a full-stack e-commerce platform using Spring Boot and MySQL backend with React frontend, deployed on AWS EC2 with S3 image storage. Implemented cart, checkout, and order history features serving end-to-end transaction workflows.

bullets: Built 6 REST endpoints in Spring Boot for the order-returns module backed by MySQL, enabling seamless return processing workflows.
Wrote JUnit tests for the returns service, raising module coverage from 45% to 70% and improving code reliability.
Debugged and resolved 12 production issues reported by the support team, demonstrating strong problem-solving and system troubleshooting skills.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with Python or JavaScript to match the JD's core language requirements; consider contributing to open-source projects or building a side project in one of these languages.

Study and document System Design and Distributed Systems concepts through real projects; build a microservices-based application or contribute to a distributed system to demonstrate practical knowledge.
Pursue GCP certification (Associate Cloud Engineer) or migrate your ShopEase project from AWS to GCP to gain direct Google Cloud Platform experience and familiarity with its services.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid backend fundamentals, but the JD targets mid-level engineers with 1+ year of production experience across multiple languages and distributed systems. Focus on gaining 6-12 months of full-time backend experience and expanding your language portfolio (Python, JavaScript, C++) to be a competitive candidate for this role.
